title: Hunt Pattern
rules_text: Embermaw closes. Hold its front, then leave the marked breath cone.

instant_beats.title: Close the Gap
instant_beats.rules_text: Embermaw advances one hex toward the guardian. Distance is not an answer for long.

instant_beats.title: Raking Claw
instant_beats.rules_text: Target: Tank. Deal 4 damage. Movement does not evade this hit. An unheld Guarded Front suffers +3.

instant_beats.title: Ash Trail
instant_beats.rules_text: The ground the claw struck burns away for good. Absorb the hit cleanly and the ash falls behind you instead.

incoming_beats.title: Hold the Front
incoming_beats.rules_text: Mitigate the claw, then clear the cone.
